title: Justice & Injustice
subtitle: Fairness at the Playground
keyMessage: Share, take turns, and make room for everyone.

scenes.heading: A fair day at the playground
scenes.narration: Welcome to the playground. Today Ruhi and her friends are learning what fairness feels like.

scenes.heading: Is this fair?
scenes.narration: A tray has six sweets. One child takes them all, while the friends beside her get none.

scenes.heading: Everyone gets a share
scenes.narration: Ruhi pauses the game. The friends share the sweets so everyone can enjoy one together.

scenes.heading: Wait, then take a turn
scenes.narration: Next, three children want the slide. They line up, wait patiently, and take turns.

scenes.heading: Make room in the game
scenes.narration: A friend stands alone. Ruhi smiles and asks, Would you like to play with us?

scenes.heading: Fairness helps us belong
scenes.narration: Fairness means sharing, taking turns, and making sure nobody is left out.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Your turn. If a child is left out of a game, what is one fair thing you could do?

title: Wealth & Poverty
subtitle: More Than Money
keyMessage: Money does not decide how much a person matters.

scenes.heading: A game at the market
scenes.narration: At the market, Sami and Noor each bring play coins to choose a game together.

scenes.heading: Different amounts
scenes.narration: Sami has many coins, and Noor has just a few. Families can have different amounts of money.

scenes.heading: People are more than money
scenes.narration: Having more coins does not make Sami a better person. Having fewer does not make Noor less important.

scenes.heading: Choose a game together
scenes.narration: They find a game they can both play. Sami shares the chalk, and Noor picks first.

scenes.heading: Friendship is not measured in coins
scenes.narration: They laugh, draw, and take turns. Their friendship is not measured in coins.

scenes.heading: Be kind and respectful
scenes.narration: We can be respectful when families have different amounts of money, and we never tease.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Think about it. A friend has fewer coins. What kind thing could you do together?

title: Equality of Opportunity
subtitle: Everyone Gets a Chance
keyMessage: Everyone deserves a chance to join, choose, and try.

scenes.heading: Different favourites
scenes.narration: In the garden, friends enjoy different foods and different games.

scenes.heading: Our choices can be different
scenes.narration: Ruhi likes cucumbers, and Layla chooses mango. Both choices are good for them.

scenes.heading: Everyone gets to choose
scenes.narration: At playtime, everyone gets a chance to choose an activity and try it.

scenes.heading: More ways to join
scenes.narration: The group sets out a soft ball, a hoop, and picture cards so there are choices.

scenes.heading: Make space for a friend
scenes.narration: A child wants more time to join. Friends make space and offer a turn.

scenes.heading: A chance for everyone
scenes.narration: Fair opportunity means everyone has a chance to take part, even when we like different things.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Your turn. What can you do to help every friend join a game?

title: Challenging Injustice
subtitle: Make Things Right
keyMessage: Tell the truth, say sorry, and help repair the harm.

scenes.heading: A moment at art time
scenes.narration: During art time, Adam bumps a tall block tower, and it falls.

scenes.heading: Mistakes can happen
scenes.narration: Adam feels worried. He could walk away, but he chooses to tell the truth.

scenes.heading: Tell the truth and say sorry
scenes.narration: I knocked it over. I am sorry, Adam says to his friends.

scenes.heading: Listen and work together
scenes.narration: His friends listen. Together, they gather the blocks and start again.

scenes.heading: Help make it right
scenes.narration: Adam helps rebuild the tower, then checks that everyone is ready to play.

scenes.heading: Speak kindly when something is unfair
scenes.narration: When we see a mistake or something unfair, we can speak kindly and help make it right.

scenes.heading: Your turn to think!
scenes.narration: Quick question. What is one brave way to make things right after a mistake?
